canonical_name: Ngo Bao Chau's proof of the Fundamental Lemma
canonical_statement: The Langlands-Shelstad Fundamental Lemma, in the Lie-algebra form proved by Ngo: for the endoscopic data, matching regular semisimple elements, transfer-factor normalization, Haar measures, and unit test functions specified in the cited source, the corresponding stable endoscopic orbital integral equals the transfer-factor-weighted orbital integral; the characteristic-zero case is subject to the source's sufficiently-large residual-characteristic condition.
domain_and_universes: Nonarchimedean local field, reductive group and endoscopic datum, integral/hyperspecial models, regular semisimple matching data, measures, transfer factor, and orbital integrals; exact Lean universes remain open.
quantifiers: reductive group and endoscopic datum satisfying the source hypotheses
matching regular semisimple element(s) in the Lie algebra
compatible measures, transfer factor, and unit test functions
hypotheses: the source's endoscopic and regular-semisimple hypotheses
the source's normalization and measure conventions
positive characteristic, or characteristic zero with sufficiently large residue characteristic
conclusion: The source-normalized stable endoscopic orbital integral and transfer-factor-weighted orbital integral agree.

alternate_encodings.warning: It uses Prop-valued surrogate structures and arbitrary comparison functions and does not encode the source theorem's unit functions, stable sums, centralizers, measures, or transfer-factor definitions.

alternate_encodings.target: group version of the Fundamental Lemma

excluded_degenerate_cases: Singular/non-regular matching data and arbitrary test functions are not included merely by the phrase Fundamental Lemma. No characteristic or normalization hypothesis may be silently removed.
